verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for a SaaS experimentation platform with management APIs, so the axis applies. The evidence documents an Experiment management API, an OpenAPI spec and an MCP server. None of it mentions issuing scoped, read-only, project-limited or otherwise least-privilege keys or tokens for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
